name: Question Asked — Crew Retrieval & Citation Integrity Hook
description: Verifies that when a question is asked, context retrieval (rankByCosine), Researcher agent synthesis, mandatory verbatim citations (R-PBT-1), confidence scoring (R-PBT-2), and IndexedDB answer persistence remain compliant.

actions.prompt: Verify that the question-answering pipeline: (1) retrieves top-5 chunks via requestIdleCallback cosine similarity, (2) invokes the Researcher agent with zero external network calls, (3) attaches verbatim citations (<=50 words) satisfying R-PBT-1 and uncertainty notices when confidence < 0.6, and (4) stores the AnswerRecord in IndexedDB. Run `npx vitest run tests/unit/researcher.test.ts tests/unit/search.test.ts`.
